narrative.overview: Pi Desktop is a purpose-built instrument for sustained coding work: quiet when idle, precise when active, and transparent when Pi uses tools. A continuous blue-charcoal shell joins navigation, conversation, inspector, and terminal rather than presenting a dashboard of floating cards.
keyCharacteristics: Continuous joined panes with fine structural separators.
Cool near-white type over charcoal tonal layers.
Violet reserved for focus, selection, streaming, and primary action.
Spacious first launch; compact, stable density during work.
Motion acknowledges state without delaying input or moving layout.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Violet marks the current action or location, never ambient decoration across every surface.

rules.name: The Tool, Not Costume Rule
rules.body: Monospace communicates literal machine content, never generic technical flavor.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface earns elevation only when it must sit above another interaction layer.

dos: Do keep project trust, connection, model, thinking, active run, and errors findable.
Do preserve alignment and stable dimensions while text or tool output streams.
donts: Don't imitate Pi's TUI or another coding desktop product.
Don't use decorative glass, neon glows, fake metrics, gradient text, or visual noise.
